prediction_periods.description: Number of periods to predict into the future
prediction_periods.title: Prediction Periods

additional_continuous_covariates.description: Continuous covariates to include as lagged predictors in the INLA model. Defaults match the legacy CHAP-EWARS model which used rainfall and mean_temperature. Override via POST /api/v1/configs to run with a different covariate set.
additional_continuous_covariates.title: Additional Continuous Covariates

n_lags.description: Number of lags per covariate, in the same order as additional_continuous_covariates. A single-element list broadcasts to all covariates.
n_lags.title: N Lags

precision.description: Prior on the precision of fixed effects. Works as regularization
precision.title: Precision

region_seasonal.description: Optional inclusion of region specific seasonal effects
region_seasonal.title: Region Seasonal
